# Ahmed Qotb (أحمد قطب)

> Official portfolio of Ahmed Qotb — Software Engineer & Web Designer from Egypt.

## About
Ahmed Qotb (also known as Ahmed Abdo / أحمد عبدو / أحمد قطب) is a Software Engineer and Web Designer based in Egypt. He is the founder of Ao Company, specializing in professional website design, web applications, and management systems.
